utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — I’ll bring the drill and help out.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, Bo — bring the drill and we’ll keep things moving. I’m still spreading the word: drop off repairs by the curb, and we’ll sort them in order.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — I’ll bring the drill and help keep things moving.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Faye — the repair drive’s now on Sunday at the community center, and I’ll share the time as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Rosa — Sunday at the community center works, and once you have the time I’ll line it up around school pickup and drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, Faye — I’ll send the time as soon as it’s set so you can plan around pickup and drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive — let me check what still needs fixing and I’ll let you know the time as soon as I’ve got it.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — just let me know the time and what still needs fixing, and I’ll bring the screwdriver set and duct tape.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Sam — I’ll check what still needs fixing and get the time to you as soon as I can.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Noah — we’re starting soon, and it’d help if you can bring any basic tools or spare parts you have. I’ll keep everything organized at the table so repairs can move along in order.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — I can bring what I have. I’m still a little fuzzy on the exact list, but I think it’s the loose fence and squeaky gate.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’s exactly the kind of thing we can handle first—thanks, Noah. Bring whatever tools you’ve got, and I’ll point folks to the fence and gate repairs when you arrive.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’s great, Noah — thank you. We’ll be in good shape with your drill and help at the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Glad to help — I’ll bring the drill and keep an ear out for a couple more volunteers too.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’s fantastic, Ira — thank you. With your drill and a few more helpers, we’ll be all set for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great — it’s Saturday at 10 AM by the community shed, and we could still use screwdrivers, gloves, and any spare paint.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can bring gloves and some spare paint by 10.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’s perfect, Leo — thank you! See you Saturday at 10 by the community shed.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late — what do you need me to grab for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Could you bring the screwdriver set and step ladder? And if you know the exact repairs and day, please tell me so I can plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I’ll bring the screwdriver set and step ladder around 3, and I can help wherever you need me. I’ll check on the exact repairs and day, too.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, it’s been busy all morning—tools and snacks are coming in steadily. If you’re heading over, I can tell you what’s still needed and where to drop things off.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Tess—what do you still need most, and is the community shed still the drop-off spot?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yes, the community shed is still the drop-off spot, and we could really use a few more screwdrivers, tape, and basic first-aid supplies. I’ll point you to the best table when you get here.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Do you want me to bring any tools, or will you have everything there?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Mina — if you’ve got a screwdriver set or a step ladder, that’d be a big help. I’ll confirm the time and place as soon as it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — I’ll bring a screwdriver set and a step ladder.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, I’m still good for Saturday morning. Just let me know the pickup details, and I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you remind me what needs picking up and where we should meet on Saturday morning?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sure — they need a few boxed tool donations and some snack bins picked up from the community center and the hardware shop. Let’s meet at the church lot Saturday morning, and I’ll go from there.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can bring screwdrivers and gloves, and I’ll check if I have any spare paint too.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect, Rey — that covers the big stuff. I’ll make a quick inventory and let you know if anything else is still needed.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Great, I’ll wait for your inventory and keep an eye out for anything else you need.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Absolutely — just send me the drop-off spot and I’ll keep track of it for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, so it’s still on — I just need the drop-off spot confirmed, right?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes — once you confirm the drop-off spot, I’ll keep track of it for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure — I can bring screwdrivers, gloves, and any spare paint I have. What’s the main repair you want help with?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Rey — the main thing is the curbside repair table, so bring the screwdrivers, gloves, and any spare paint, and I’ll keep spreading the word about when and where to show up.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Got it — I’ll bring the screwdrivers, gloves, and whatever spare paint I can find for the curbside repair table.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — I’ll bring the drill and help out.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late — I can grab the screwdriver set and duct tape. I’ll swing by around 3 and help out.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — thanks, Dane. See you around 3.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So it’s still on, but the timing and drop-off spot are still unconfirmed, right?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, that sounds right — I think it’s still on, but I’d better double-check the timing and where to drop things off.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, thanks — just let me know once you’ve confirmed the timing and drop-off spot, and I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes — that’s right. I just need the timing and drop-off spot confirmed first, then I can see what I can bring.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: The drop-off spot is the school parking lot by the gym, and I’m just waiting on the time to confirm it. Once that comes in, I’ll keep track of any repair drive updates.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great, the location works for me. Just send me the time when it’s confirmed, and I’ll check what I can bring.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Absolutely—I'll keep asking around for a couple more helpers too. Just send me the pickup spot and exact time when you have it.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great — let’s plan for 3:00 at the repair drive pickup spot. I’ll bring the screwdriver set and duct tape.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Perfect, 3:00 works for me—I’ll see you at the pickup spot. I’ll keep an eye out for any last-minute helpers too.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’m checking our supplies now — if you can bring screwdrivers, gloves, or spare paint, that’d help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Cleo — I’ll bring screwdrivers and gloves, and I’ll share the Sunday community center time as soon as it’s confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect, thank you — I’ll keep checking what else we still need for the drive.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you remind me which repairs are still needed and whether the drive is definitely this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — it’s definitely this Saturday at 10 AM by the community shed, and we still need screwdrivers, gloves, and any spare paint.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks — I’ve got Saturday at 10 AM by the community shed, and I’ll bring that info along. Do you still need help with the fence or gate too?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it — I heard we still need screwdrivers, gloves, and spare paint, and it starts at 10 AM Saturday at the community shed. I’ll pass that along.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Nell — that’s perfect. I’ll make sure we’ve got the tools ready and be there at 10 on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Great, thanks, Gus — I’ll keep spreading the word and let folks know the community shed is the place to be at 10 on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Dane — that covers it. We’re just waiting on Eli now, then we can get the repair drive rolling.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Saturday morning still works for me, and I’ll keep the pickup word going. If anyone can bring duct tape, screwdrivers, or extension cords, that’d be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect, Eli — I’ll spread the word and see who can bring the duct tape and screwdrivers. Saturday morning it is, and we’ll get this repair drive rolling.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, it’s been a nice steady trickle all morning — mostly tools, snacks, and a few odds and ends. If you’re coming by, I can tell you what they still need.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can come by around 3. If you still need anything, tell me what to bring.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’d be great — they still need a good flashlight, a couple rolls of duct tape, and any spare screwdrivers you’ve got. See you around 3!

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Oren—just send me the repair drive time when you have it, and I’ll coordinate around school pickup and drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, I’m on it—I’ll check what still needs fixing and find the time for the repair drive, then I’ll send it over.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, thanks, Oren — I’ll plan around pickup and drop-off once you send the time.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’d be wonderful, Mina — thank you. We’re gathering tools, a few volunteers, and any broken items folks want help fixing.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What’s the pickup spot and exact time for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’ll check the pickup spot and exact time, Mina, and get right back to you.
